text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (I won! I can go toe to toe against<n>those two!)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... I never saw that coming... She<n>beat two
Mejiros...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I can't believe it... I thought for<n>sure one of
those two was going to<n>win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I may have lost today, but next time,<n>the glory's
mine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And I'm sure McQueen feels just the<n>same! I
know she's going to do her<n>best to live up to all
your<n>expectations! And that's not all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen isn't the only runner in the<n>Mejiro family!
And at the Takarazuka<n>Kinen, I, Mejiro Ryan, will
show you<n>that I'm not to be ignored!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! That's right! I'll always be<n>rooting for you,
Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I don't know if I could've said<n>something like that
after missing out<n>on first place...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Would I have the composure to think<n>about how
my fans are reacting to my<n>performance, and how
to reassure<n>them?)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(...No, there's no way. I wouldn't be<n>able to hide my
disappointment.<n>That's the difference between
Ryan<n>and me.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Those are the words of someone<n>who's lived
shouldering<n>expectations.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: At the Takarazuka Kinen, that's<n>gonna be me!

Standing in the winner's circle, Ines<n>Fujin makes
this vow with her hand<n>on her chest.
